title: General inclusions for ideals generated by matrix minors
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $A$ a finite $p\times n$ matrix over $R$ [def-weil-matrix]. For $r\ge0$, let $J_r(A)$ be the ideal generated by the determinants [def-weil-pbc-matrix-determinant] of its $r\times r$ submatrices [def-weil-submatrix], with $J_0(A)=R$ and $J_r(A)=0$ when $r>\min(p,n)$. Then (1) $J_{r+1}(A)\subseteq J_r(A)$; (2) if $B$ is a $p\times(n+d)$ matrix whose first $n$ columns are $A$, where $d\ge0$, then $J_{r+d}(B)\subseteq J_r(A)$; (3) for every $n\times n$ matrix $C$ over $R$, one has $J_r(AC)\subseteq J_r(A)$, where $(AC)_{ij}=\sum_{h=1}^n A_{ih}C_{hj}$. These statements include empty matrices and $r=0$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07Z7 (lemma-ideals-generated-by-minors), parts (1), (2), (3); (2) and (3) written for transposed matrices so that appended rows become appended columns and left multiplication becomes right multiplication.
